title: Wearing unauthorized insignia, decoration, badge, ribbon, device, or lapel button.
bodyText:
Any person subject to this chapter who:

(1) Is not authorized to wear an insignia, decoration, badge, ribbon, device, or lapel button; and

(2) Wrongfully wears any insignia, decoration, badge, ribbon, device, or lapel button upon the person's uniform or civilian clothing,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.
bodyHtml:
[§124B-170]  Wearing unauthorized insignia, decoration, badge, ribbon, device, or lapel button.  Any person subject to this chapter who:

     (1)  Is not authorized to wear an insignia, decoration, badge, ribbon, device, or lapel button; and

     (2)  Wrongfully wears any insignia, decoration, badge, ribbon, device, or lapel button upon the person's uniform or civilian clothing,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
